M8 MLBB: when it starts, who has qualified and which CIS teams are going

Team Spirit starts in the Istanbul main stage. Aurevia Team and Team Yandex begin in the Bangkok Wild Card.

Dates and venues

In this story
When and where M8 takes placeM8 teamsCIS teams at M8MCT SEA qualifiers

In short

  • The Wild Card stage takes place in December 2026 in Bangkok: 10 teams play for 3 Main Stage places.
  • The Main Stage is in January 2027 in Istanbul: 16 teams and a $1,000,000 prize pool.
  • Team Spirit, the MCC Season 8 champion, reached the Main Stage for the CIS. Aurevia Team and Team Yandex play in the Wild Card.
  • The last places are decided at MCT SEA on 9–13 December: the top two go to the Main Stage, 3rd and 4th to the Wild Card.

As of 22 November, exact match dates had yet to be announced. The months are confirmed for the Bangkok Wild Card and the Istanbul main stage.

When and where M8 takes place

  1. Wild CardDecember 2026

    Bangkok, Thailand

    10 teams, 3 Main Stage places
  2. Main Stage and finalsJanuary 2027

    Istanbul, Türkiye

    16 teams, $1,000,000 prize pool

MCT SEA will add two more Wild Card teams.

CIS teams at M8

Three CIS teams are going to M8. Team Spirit won MCC Season 8 4:0 against Aurevia Team and went straight to the Main Stage in Istanbul. This is the same Team Spirit that won MSC 2026 in the summer. Aurevia Team and Team Yandex start in the Bangkok Wild Card: to reach Istanbul they need a top-three finish among 10 teams.

What this means for viewers in Russia

Istanbul will have at least one CIS team in January, and up to three after a good Wild Card. Türkiye shares Moscow’s time zone, so Main Stage matches will air at convenient hours.

MCT SEA qualifiers

MCT SEA, ICONSIAM, Bangkok
DatesStageWhat is decided
9–10 DecemberGroup stage12 teams from 11 countries in four groups
10 DecemberLast Chance QualifierOne BO1 match for the last playoff place
11–13 DecemberPlayoffsplaces 1–2 go to the M8 Main Stage, places 3–4 to the Wild Card

The MCT SEA prize pool is $50,000.

After MCT SEA the M8 field will be complete: two Southeast Asian teams go straight to Istanbul and two more join the Wild Card. We will update the tables after the playoffs on 13 December and when MOONTON publishes the match days.

Frequently asked questions

When and where is MLBB M8?

The Wild Card is in December 2026 in Bangkok, the Main Stage in January 2027 in Istanbul.

What is the M8 prize pool?

$1,000,000 for the 16 Main Stage teams.

Which CIS teams play at M8?

Team Spirit is already in the Main Stage as the MCC Season 8 champion. Aurevia Team and Team Yandex play in the Wild Card.
